drill: the pre-commit hook, watched refusing and watched permitting
hook: scripts/hooks/pre-commit -> .git/hooks/pre-commit (untracked by git, so this record is a statement about the machine it ran on)

arms.A_negative_control: an ordinary staged file commits, and the hook is proved to have RUN
arms.B_refusal: a generated AWS-shaped credential staged; git commit REFUSED, HEAD unmoved, secret never printed
arms.C_documented_limit: git commit --no-verify commits the same plant — the bypass is measured, not claimed — and the audit of record still catches it

what_this_does_not_prove: that the hook is installed in any other clone. .git/hooks is untracked; make security-scan remains the audit of record.
